description: Compute class component state updates from the updater callback's previous-state argument instead of this.state; setState batches updates, so this.state may be stale.

violation.message: Pass setState an updater function and read the previous state from its argument instead of this.state.
This this.state read reaches setState through $DECLNAME; pass setState an updater function and read the previous state from its argument.
The state destructured from this here reaches setState; pass setState an updater function and read the previous state from its argument.
This this.state read reaches a setState call through $CALLEE(); pass setState an updater function and read the previous state from its argument.
